purpose: Manual retrieval and citation smoke test; not a measured benchmark

cases.question: Under EQ-17, when must equipment be returned?
cases.expect: Five working days normally; identify the ten-day field-team exception if applicable.

cases.question: Does the rule differ for field teams after July 1, 2026?
cases.expect: Ten working days for assignments beginning on or after July 1; other employees still have five.

cases.question: The desk note says five days. Why does the amendment say ten?
cases.expect: Distinguish the earlier informal reminder from the later, scoped amendment; do not treat it as a universal change.

cases.question: Who approved the amendment?
cases.expect: Name is absent. Do not infer that the owner is the approving person.

cases.question: What is the late return fee?
cases.expect: No fee is specified. Do not equate missing fee information with an explicit no-fee policy.

cases.question: How many late returns occurred last year?
cases.expect: The documents contain no late-return counts. Do not invent a number.

cases.question: Can field teams keep equipment for ten days?
cases.expect: The selected original policy does not establish a field-team exception. Do not cite excluded documents.
